value_updates.big_block_ticket_counter: Display a separate current Big Block ticket counter and reset it to 0 after each Big Block draw.

verdicts.decision_note: The source establishes dashboard display and per-NFT ticket association; ticket issuance itself belongs to the separate issuance Requirement.
This source defines no-code or invalid-code ticket allocation and popup behavior, not accounting accuracy after a ticket is awarded.

value_updates.aggregate_ticket_count_rule: The number of accounted tickets equals the number of mints, excluding secondary-market sales.
value_updates.random_ticket_accounting: Tickets assigned at random for no-referral mints must be registered in ticket totals.
